scope: Small actual editorless None NTFS/WinFsp original/A/B lifecycle only; two separate ABBA blocks.

measurement.groupSeconds: Sum of CLI RunAsync elapsed seconds; release includes its own final capture.
measurement.wallSeconds: All four script stages, including 27 CLI dispatches, process startup, schema/status, edits and harness overhead; seed excluded.

fixes.cause: Initial observation waited for absent launch/state publication despite the first connection having no launcher.
fixes.change: Acquire the same client.lock as Start. Skip absent launch/state grace only while held; busy lock uses normal observation, unresolved intent retains uncertainty/state grace.

fixes.cause: Initial connection waited one second for a missing owned request.
fixes.change: Skip only absence grace under the existing coordinator workspace operation lock; sharing/identity checks remain.

fixes.cause: First stopped-journal reclamation waited one second for its not-yet-published intent.
fixes.change: Skip only absence grace under the existing operation lock; complete stopped/seal/inventory proof and same-intent recovery remain.

testBottleneck.cause: Each case recreated a real Git fixture, captured/resolved basis and seeded a journal with repeated default-reader availability proof; cases ran serially.
testBottleneck.rejectedHypothesis: Adding matching launch records did not improve the pilot and was reverted.
testBottleneck.change: Fixture uses exact leased Git read scope with explicit final VerifyReadBoundary; independent cases run with bounded parallelism and 10-second individual cancellation.

remainingCosts.finding: Remaining small-input capture cost spans native capture, metadata/range preservation, independent verification, pruning and backend completion. Capture/apply did not improve in the final comparison; no additional unproved proof-elision was adopted.

limits: Two samples per candidate per block; scheduling/cache/storage variation remains.
